subject: Follow-up: Knowledge retrieval configuration & evaluation plan — Lexicon Health pilot
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@lexiconhealth.com>, Dr. Aaron Brenner <aaron.brenner@lexiconhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Knowledge retrieval configuration & evaluation plan — Lexicon Health pilot

Hi Hannah / Aaron —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear about the physician-facing decision-support use case and the need for strict grounding on institutional protocols. Per our discussion I summarized the recommended retrieval + reranker baseline and the short evaluation plan so we can validate model fit before the pilot. Low-friction next steps are at the bottom.

Summary of what we heard from you:
- Primary content: clinical protocols, internal memos, and 10k+ patient-facing Q&As (PDFs + HTML).
- Target UX: single-turn Q&A and short summarization (1–3 sentences) with explicit citations to source documents.
- SLOs: sub-500ms p50 answer latency, hallucination rate <2% on curated prompts, grounding precision >95% for top-1.

Recommended baseline configuration (pilot):
1) Retriever: hybrid BM25 + dense (Faiss / HNSW) with 2k token chunking and 50% overlap; candidate pool k=100.
2) Reranker: cross-encoder re-ranker (Redwood-cross-encoder-small) for top-100 -> re-score top-5. Tradeoff: higher CPU for lower hallucination.
3) Model: Redwood-13B-v2-quant for initial pilot (good cost/quality balance); recommend Redwood-70B for guarded production if latency budget allows.
4) Caching: prefix KV caching for common queries + document-level embedding cache.
5) Prompting: use structured output template (answer + citations array); attached is lexicon_prompt_set_v1.jsonl with 120 representative prompts you can run locally.

Evaluation metrics to collect: grounding_precision@1, retrieval_recall@10, answer_F1 (against curated gold answers), hallucination_rate (false assertions per 100 answers), latency_p50/p95. See attached benchmark-results-lexicon-20260312.pdf for our synthetic sims.

Potential risks and mitigations:
- Regression risk across model upgrades: tie all checks to the prompt set and enable automatic regression alerts in Redwood Optimize.
- Overfitting to PDFs: apply OCR normalization + document sectioning (we recommend chunk size above).

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) You run the attached prompt set locally and share raw outputs (we can ingest them into our eval harness).
2) We provision a short-lived dedicated sandbox (1 week) using Redwood-13B-v2-quant + cross-encoder reranker for you to smoke test with real content.
3) Technical sync with Marissa (solutions) to lock retrieval parameters and evaluation thresholds — suggest 30-minute call Wed or Thu.

I can kick off the sandbox once you say yes — happy to iterate on retrieval window and reranker threshold after the first run.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: lexicon_prompt_set_v1.jsonl (120 prompts), benchmark-results-lexicon-20260312.pdf
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@lexiconhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Knowledge retrieval configuration & evaluation plan — Lexicon Health pilot

Thanks, Priyom — this is helpful and matches our expectations. A few quick clarifications: 

- For the reranker, are we able to run the cross-encoder in our VPC (private deployment) or will that need to live in Redwood Dedicated? We are sensitive to PHI handling and would prefer VPC if possible.
- Our procurement lead (cc'd in the next email) wants a short scope doc for the sandbox duration/cost. Can you include a one-paragraph summary we can attach?

We will run the attached prompt set against a sampled doc bundle this afternoon and share outputs. Also looping in Aaron for a quick confirmation on the 95% grounding_precision target (Aaron?)

Best,
Hannah
Senior Program Manager, Clinical Informatics | Lexicon Health
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@lexiconhealth.com>, Dr. Aaron Brenner <aaron.brenner@lexiconhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Knowledge retrieval configuration & evaluation plan — Lexicon Health pilot

Thanks Hannah — quick answers below, and I added a one-paragraph sandbox scope at the bottom you can hand to procurement.

1) Reranker deployment: cross-encoder can run inside Lexicon's VPC using Redwood Private (we'll provide a customer-controlled container image and minimal outbound control plane traffic). For the pilot we can also host it in Redwood Dedicated if you prefer zero ops on your side — cost will be higher but quicker to stand up.

2) Sandbox cost/scope paragraph (for procurement):
Redwood will provision a one-week sandbox environment (Redwood Private or Dedicated depending on customer preference) consisting of a single inference pool running Redwood-13B-v2-quant with a cross-encoder reranker for re-scoring top-100 retrieval candidates. The sandbox includes ingestion of up to 100GB of documents, evaluation of 120 customer prompts, and access to evaluation dashboards (grounding_precision, retrieval_recall@10, latency_p50/p95). Estimated sandbox cost: $4,500 (one-time).

If that looks OK I will open a purchase order link and get the sandbox scheduled.

Operational notes for Marissa / Rishi: when we provision the sandbox please set: chunk_size=2000 tokens, chunk_overlap=50%, candidate_k=100, rerank_top=5, reranker_threshold=0.32 (initial). We'll iterate after the first run.

Thanks — looking forward to the prompt outputs.

— Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Lexicon pilot — tech checklist and owner

Priyom — copying the internal checklist so we have clear owners before we spin up infra. Short notes: 
- Eng owner: Marissa (solutions) to validate ingestion + OCR normalization.
- Infra owner: Rishi (dedicated/private provisioning).
- SRE: set autoscaling guardrails for the cross-encoder to avoid CPU spikes; set alert when reranker CPU > 70% for 10m.
- Eval: I'll import lexicon_prompt_set_v1.jsonl into the Eval harness and run the benchmark profile "lexicon-initial" (will attach results).

Also suggested tuning after first run: if grounding_precision < 90% at top-1, switch to rerank_top=10 and increase reranker_threshold to 0.4; consider moving to Redwood-70B if answer_F1 < 0.78.

I'll schedule a 30-minute technical sync for Thu 10:00 AM PT — send calendar invite and include the Lexicon sample bundle.

-Marissa
